countedBy: lane #191 (opus) from the rectified E panorama crop recording_2025-07-29_10-13-06_01026 (artifacts/landmark-briefs/vu-hoofdgebouw/w01-90.jpg, 24 px/m) and the Commons photo VU Amsterdam.jpg (north face of the east tower block, oblique); ribbon convention (two-pane windows between 0.4-0.5 m concrete piers count once each). Not a blind haiku count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: east low wing on the Buitenveldertselaan side
facades.note: Three storeys of two-pane windows between concrete piers, 19 per storey across the 82.6 m face (the right-hand end bay is an open passage at ground level in the photo, counted as a window bay above). The setback fourth storey and the tower behind are outside the crop height. The 2.4 m stub between the two roof-height sections is a closed bay (not counted).

facades.name: north face of the east tower block (griffin block)
facades.note: Glazed every second storey: window bands above the low wing, each nine two-pane windows between concrete posts; blank exposed concrete between the bands. The crop stops at 56.5 m, below the top band: in the photo the griffin and its frame stand in front of its eastern windows, so it cannot be counted.
